</span><span class="cm">/* loguser:
                 if loguser &gt;= 2  implicit denial is sent back;
                 if loguser &gt;= 4 implicit and explicit denial;
                 if loguser &gt;= 5 all filtering is sent back;
                 if loguser &gt;= 6 filtering and pre/post stuff is sent.
                 commands in do_control are always sent back: loguser
                 then decides to print or not information. To have information
                 printed on commands received _at_startup_ loguser
                 must be 7.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* loglevel
    if loglevel &gt; 3 printk of rule added in manage_rule()
    (ipfi_netl.c );
    if loglevel &gt; 2 printk of command received in do_control
    (ipfi_netl.c);
  */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_options</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nat</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">masquerade</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">all_stateful</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">free</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">user_allowed</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">noflush_on_exit</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="nl v-local">loglevel</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* logging level by means of printk */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="nl v-local">loguser</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* sending information to userspace */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">snatted_lifetime</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dnatted_lifetime</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">state_lifetime</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">setup_shutd_state_lifetime</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_lifetime</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">max_loginfo_entries</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">max_nat_entries</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">max_state_entries</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* TCP */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_TCP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">pskb_may_pull</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                       </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdrlen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">tcp_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">pr_info</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">TCP %pI4:%u -&gt; %pI4:%u</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ntohs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">source</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-func-call">ntohs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">tcph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">dest</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* UDP */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_UDP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">udph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">pskb_may_pull</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                       </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdrlen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">udph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">udp_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">pr_info</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">UDP %pI4:%u -&gt; %pI4:%u</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ntohs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">udph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">source</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-func-call">ntohs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">udph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">dest</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Other protocols */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">pr_info</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IP proto=%u %pI4 -&gt; %pI4</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">daddr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

## ipfire.c

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/* ip firewall Giacomo S. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;build.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;filter/defrag.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;filter/state/state_machine.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;globals.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;helpers/icmp_nat.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfi_machine.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;mangle/tcpmss.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;module_init.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;netlink/ipfi_netl.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;netlink/message_builder.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;proc/proc.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/init.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/list.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/module.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/netfilter.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;net/net_namespace.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;net/tcp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;net/udp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define NF_IP_PRE_ROUTING NF_INET_PRE_ROUTING</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define NF_IP_POST_ROUTING NF_INET_POST_ROUTING</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define NF_IP_LOCAL_IN NF_INET_LOCAL_IN</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define NF_IP_LOCAL_OUT NF_INET_LOCAL_OUT</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define NF_IP_FORWARD NF_INET_FORWARD</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">MODULE_LICENSE</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">GPL</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">MODULE_AUTHOR</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">Giacomo S. &lt;delleceste@gmail.com&gt;</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">MODULE_DESCRIPTION</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE-wall: A high-performance, stateful IPv4 packet filter.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">Features:</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Stateful Inspection: Advanced TCP/UDP/ICMP state tracking.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - NAT: SNAT, DNAT, and Masquerading support.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Lifecycle Management: Unified ipfi_entry with RCU and per-entry </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">timers.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Slab Allocation: Dedicated kmem_cache for state, NAT, and log </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">entries.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Smart Logging: Rate-limited, duplicate-suppressed logging system.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Protocol Helpers: Optimized support for Passive FTP.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Networking: TCP MSS clamping and IPv4 defragmentation.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Userspace: Netlink-based control, ruleset sync, and statistics.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">Network Namespaces (netns):</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - per_net=0 (default): Hooks registered in init_net only.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - per_net=1: Hooks in all namespaces; tables (state, NAT, logs) are </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">shared.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">  - Primary use: Local host firewalling and cross-netns performance </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">testing.</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Versione di test!

 * Filtro di pacchetti con funzionalita' di NAT.
 * Il software in kernel space consta di 6 moduli interdipendenti.

 * posta elettronica: delleceste@gmail.com

 * Si legga la documentazione per l'uso e l'installazione.
 * I commenti al codice e la documentazione sono in lingua inglese
 * per facilitare la lettura del codice a chi ne avesse bisogno, dal
 * momento che io stesso sono stato aiutato nello svolgimento
 * del progetto da diverse persone sparse in tutto il mondo.
 * Grazie!
 * Giacomo.
 */</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="cm">/*
 * Thanks to:
 * Alessandro Rubini, Alexander Harsch, Andrea Barberio, Jozsef Kadlecsik, Diego
 * Billi, Luigi Rizzo, Paul `Rusty' Russell, Andrew Gargan, Daniele orlandi,
 * Stephen Hemminger, Kasper Dupont, Peter T. Breuer, Tauno Voipio;
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Linux kernel 2.6.9 and above were used for test, together with
 * debian GNU/Linux - www.debian.org - and
 * slackware Linux  - www.slackware.org.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">policy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">drop</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">module_param</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">policy</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">charp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">S_IRUSR</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">S_IWUSR</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">S_IRGRP</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">S_IWGRP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">MODULE_PARM_DESC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">default_policy</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="se">\&quot;</span><span class="s">accept</span><span class="se">\&quot;</span><span class="s"> or </span><span class="se">\&quot;</span><span class="s">drop</span><span class="se">\&quot;</span><span class="s"> policy as default.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/*
 * per_net — Network namespace hook registration mode.
 *
 * 0 (default): Hooks are registered in init_net only. The firewall sees
 *              traffic on the host's main network stack. Packets inside
 *              other namespaces (even through loopback) are invisible
 *              because each namespace has its own netfilter hook chain.
 *
 * 1:           Hooks are registered in every network namespace via
 *              register_pernet_subsys(). All namespaces share the same
 *              state, NAT, and log tables (no per-namespace isolation).
 *
 * The per_net=1 mode is primarily intended for local performance testing:
 * flood traffic between namespaces on the same host to measure firewall
 * overhead without flooding the physical network.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">per_net</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">module_param</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">per_net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">S_IRUGO</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">MODULE_PARM_DESC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-param">per_net</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">Hook registration mode: 0=init_net only (default), 1=all namespaces.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">With per_net=0, traffic in non-init namespaces is not filtered.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">welcome</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* packet counters */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">long</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">in_counter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="cm">/*
 * Hook Registration
 *
 * nf_register_net_hook() is namespace-scoped: hooks only fire for packets
 * traversing the struct net they were registered in.
 *
 * per_net=0: register_ipfire_net(&amp;init_net) — only the host's own traffic.
 *            Other namespaces have their own hook chains and are unaffected.
 *
 * per_net=1: register_pernet_subsys() — hooks fire in every namespace.
 *            Useful for local performance testing: create namespaces with
 *            veth pairs and flood packets between them to measure firewall
 *            overhead, without sending any traffic on the physical network.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">timespec64</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">tv_load_time</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">init_netl</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">init_machine</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* registers netdevice notifier */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">per_net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">register_pernet_subsys</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_net_ops</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: failed to register pernet subsystem</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">register_ipfire_net</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">init_net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__init</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ini</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">welcome</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__exit</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">fini</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/*
   * ===== SHUTDOWN SEQUENCE =====
   *
   * The unified lifecycle (ipfi_entry) uses a deferred-free chain:
   *
   *   flush_all / timer_cb
   *     → ipfi_entry_put()
   *       → queue_work(ipfire_wq, cleanup_work)      [step A: work queued]
   *         → free_entry_work()
   *           → timer_delete_sync()
   *           → call_rcu(free_entry_rcu)              [step B: RCU cb queued]
   *             → free_entry_rcu()
   *               → kfree(h)                          [step C: actual free]
   *
   * To safely destroy kmem_cache, we must ensure step C has completed
   * for ALL entries. This requires:
   *
   *   1. we_are_exiting = true        → stop new allocations
   *   2. synchronize_net()            → finish in-flight packet hooks
   *   3. unregister hooks             → no more packets
   *   4. fini_machine / fini_log /    → flush_all queues work items (step A)
   *      fini_translation
   *   5. destroy_workqueue(ipfire_wq) → flushes &amp; runs all work items,
   *                                      which post call_rcu (step B)
   *   6. rcu_barrier()                → waits for all call_rcu callbacks
   *                                      to finish (step C — kfree done)
   *   7. kmem_cache_destroy(...)      → now safe, all objects freed
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* --- Step 1: signal exit --- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">WRITE_ONCE</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">we_are_exiting</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">true</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* --- Step 2: unregister hooks ---
   * Stop new packets from entering the module's paths */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">per_net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">unregister_pernet_subsys</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_net_ops</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">unregister_ipfire_net</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">init_net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* --- Step 3: wait for in-flight RCU readers (packet hooks) ---
   * synchronize_net() calls synchronize_rcu() internally.
   * Note: synchronize_rcu() only waits for _readers_, NOT for
   * call_rcu() _callbacks_ — that's what rcu_barrier() is for.
   * We do this AFTER unregistering hooks so we know no new
   * packets are entering. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">synchronize_net</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* --- Step 4: flush all tables ---
   * Each fini function calls ipfi_table_flush_hash() (or flush_all for LRU
   * lists), which:
   *   - iterates buckets/lists, marks entries REMOVED
   *   - calls ipfi_entry_put() → queues cleanup work on ipfire_wq */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">fini_machine</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">fini_log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">fini_translation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* fini_netl(): just calls sock_release on the netlink socket */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">fini_netl</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">clean_proc</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* --- Step 5: flush the workqueue ---
   * destroy_workqueue() drains all pending work items.
   * This runs free_entry_work() for every entry, which calls
   * timer_delete_sync() + call_rcu(free_entry_rcu).
   * After this, all call_rcu callbacks are _posted_ but may
   * not have _executed_ yet. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_wq</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">destroy_workqueue</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_wq</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">ipfire_wq</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* --- Step 6: wait for all RCU callbacks ---
   * rcu_barrier() blocks until every call_rcu(free_entry_rcu)
   * posted in step 5 has finished executing (i.e., kfree done).
   * After this returns, no slab objects are in use. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">rcu_barrier</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* --- Step 7: destroy slab caches ---
   * All objects have been freed, safe to tear down the caches. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">kmem_cache_destroy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">state_cache</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">kmem_cache_destroy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nat_cache</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">kmem_cache_destroy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_cache</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_counters</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">free_percpu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_counters</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">set_policy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">def_policy</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">strncmp</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">def_policy</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">accept</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">6</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">kstats</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">policy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">default_policy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">kstats</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">policy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">default_policy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_DROP</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">init_options</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_options</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">opts</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memset</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">opts</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_options</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* by default, users are allowed to insert their rules.
   * Administrator, to avoid users' rules, have to start
   * firewall with option noflush and disabling users */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-param">opts</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">user_allowed</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="c1">// enum nf_ip_hook_priorities {
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_FIRST = INT_MIN,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_CONNTRACK_DEFRAG = -400,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_RAW = -300,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_SELINUX_FIRST = -225,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_CONNTRACK = -200,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_MANGLE = -150,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_NAT_DST = -100,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_FILTER = 0,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_SECURITY = 50,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_NAT_SRC = 100,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_SELINUX_LAST = 225,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_CONNTRACK_CONFIRM = INT_MAX,
</span><span class="c1">// 	NF_IP_PRI_LAST = INT_MAX,
</span><span class="c1">// };
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/*
 * register_ipfire_net - Initialize and register netfilter hooks for a namespace
 *
 * This function sets up the hook structures (nf_hook_ops) that define our
 * packet processing callbacks, then registers them in the given namespace.
 *
 * Returns: 0 on success, negative error code on failure
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">register_ipfire_net</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">net</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">net</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Setup hook structures (using global ops for simplicity if they can be
   * shared)
   * Note: In modern kernels, nf_hook_ops can be shared if they are immutable.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* PRE_ROUTING: Defragmentation hook (highest priority) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">pf</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">PF_INET</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hook</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_defrag</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_INET_PRE_ROUTING</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_defrag_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">priority</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRI_CONNTRACK_DEFRAG</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* pre routing */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">pf</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">PF_INET</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRE_ROUTING</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">priority</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRI_NAT_DST</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_pre</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hook</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">process</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* input */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_in</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">pf</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">PF_INET</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_in</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_LOCAL_IN</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_in</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">priority</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRI_FILTER</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_in</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hook</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">process</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* forward */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_fwd</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">pf</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">PF_INET</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_fwd</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_FORWARD</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_fwd</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">priority</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRI_FILTER</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_fwd</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hook</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">process</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* output */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">nfh_out</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">pf</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">PF_INET</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
