</span><span class="w">                 </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_dnatted_count</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_snatted_count</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">switch</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">hooknum</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">case</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="no v-local">NF_IP_PRE_ROUTING</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">no_nat</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">pre_rcv</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">     </span><span class="c1">// stats
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* save original destination address */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">flow</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_INPUT_PRE</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_pre_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// if (ret != NF_DROP &amp;&amp; ret != NF_STOLEN &amp;&amp; daddr != ip_hdr(skb)-&gt;daddr) {
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// destination nat applied and destination address changed in pre routing
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// dst_release(skb_dst(skb));
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// skb_dst_set(skb, NULL);
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="c1">// }
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">case</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="no v-local">NF_IP_LOCAL_IN</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">in_rcv</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">flow</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_INPUT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_response</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">case</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="no v-local">NF_IP_LOCAL_OUT</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">out_rcv</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">flow</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_OUTPUT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* 1. Evaluate firewall rules and update state based on ORIGINAL destination
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_response</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* 2. Apply OUTPUT DNAT (which modifies the destination) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-local">no_nat</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">local_output_dnat</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_DROP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_DROP</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">case</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="no v-local">NF_IP_FORWARD</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">fwd_rcv</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">flow</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_FWD</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_response</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">case</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="no v-local">NF_IP_POST_ROUTING</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">no_nat</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">post_rcv</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">flow</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_OUTPUT_POST</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_post_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">default</span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_DROP</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_DROP</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">init_kernel_stats</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">kernel_stats</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">nl_kstats</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memset</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">nl_kstats</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">kernel_stats</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* updates sent counter, sends packet to userspace and calls
 * update_kernel_stats()
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">send_packet_to_userspace_and_update_counters</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">skb_to_user</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">skb_to_user</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">build_info_t_nlmsg</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb_to_user</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">sent_tou</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_send_to_user</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb_to_user</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">LISTENER_DATA</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">printk</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">send_packet_to_userspace_and_update_counters skb_send failed</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">update_kernel_stats</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_FAILED_NETLINK_USPACE</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">resp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb_to_user</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: failed to allocate memory for socket buffer in </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">send_packet_to_userspace_and_update_counters()</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_pre_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">verdict</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* in pre routing we do not do any filtering. In normal cases we will return
   * IPFI_ACCEPT as verdict in this hook. In case of errors instead, we'll
   * return IPFI_DROP, to interrupt packet processing. This happens in case of
   * checksum error in incoming packets or (unprobable) memory allocation
   * errors
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* MASQUERADE or NAT are enabled: go on! */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* No more kmalloc for ipfire_info_t. We use stack-based flags and response.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* No more build_ipfire_info_from_skb or init_packet needed for translation
   * here. Translation functions now take skb and components directly.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* if it's an ICMP error for a NATed connection, handle it directly */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_ICMP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">icmp_nat_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_PRE_ROUTING</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* The outer Dst IP changed (e.g. local .245 -&gt; remote .25).
       * The cached routing decision (LOCAL_IN) is now stale.
       * Drop it so the kernel re-evaluates routing → FORWARD.
       */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* if a packet comes back from a dnatted connection,
   * i.e. has been forwarded, we must de dnat it. Dynamic
   * rules are checked in this case.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">get_dnatted_count</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">pre_de_dnat</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* implements pre processing of the packets: DNAT.
     * check if we already have a translation for this session
     * (early lookup consolidated here)
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">dnt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">lookup_nat_forward</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_DNAT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dnt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">dest_translate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dnt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dnt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* dnat_translation() requires direct match with DNAT rules inserted by user.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* no pre_de_dnat, maybe dnat_translation */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">dnat_translation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* now let's de-snat, or de-masquerade, if no match has previously succeeded
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_snatted_count</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">pre_de_snat</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* checksum is calculated inside set_pairs_in_skb(), ipfi_translation.c */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">nat</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* we send to userspace old packet, to let see how translation changed it,
     * if loguser is greater than 5 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">userspace_data_pid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">loguser_enabled</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">is_to_send</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">fwopts</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">send_packet_to_userspace_and_update_counters</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* not sent because of log level */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">not_sent</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">BAD_CHECKSUM</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">we_are_exiting</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">not_sent</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_DROP</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">bad_checksum_in</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: bad checksum on incoming packet %llu over %llu received.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">this_cpu_read</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_counters</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">bad_checksum_in</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">this_cpu_read</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ipfi_counters</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">pre_rcv</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* send a packet signaling an error */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">send_packet_to_userspace_and_update_counters</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_DROP</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* No more kfree(packet) needed */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">verdict</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_post_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* do post routing tasks. Checksumming is performed in set_pairs_in_skb(),
   * the manipulation function inside ipfi_translation.c
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">de_dnat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* stats — use per-CPU counters to avoid cache-line bouncing */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">post_rcv</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* No more kmalloc for ipfire_info_t. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* MASQUERADE and SNAT now take components directly. No
   * build_ipfire_info_from_skb needed here. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* if it's an ICMP error for a NATed connection, handle it directly */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_ICMP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">icmp_nat_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_IP_POST_ROUTING</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* Translation applied, accept packet immediately */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">post_rcv</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">send_touser</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">get_dnatted_count</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/*
     * Consolidate: both post_snat_dynamic() and de_dnat_translation()
     * do lookup_nat_idx(NAT_DNAT, NAT_IDX_POSTNAT, skb), which probes
     * the exact same hash bucket. Do ONE lookup and handle both cases:
     *   - dynamic masquerade (forward packet through DNAT entry)
     *   - de-DNAT (reply packet returning from DNAT target)
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">lookup_nat_idx</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_DNAT</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_POSTNAT</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* Try dynamic masquerade first (forward direction) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">snat_dynamic_table_match</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">state_machine</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_update_timer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">snat_dynamic_translate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Update/Add Reply index with the new Masquerade address */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">                                             </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">our_ifaddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                             </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_add_index</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_REPLY</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">reply_key</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">send_touser</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* Try de-DNAT (reverse direction) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">de_dnat_table_match</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">state_machine</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_update_timer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">de_dnat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">de_dnat</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dntmp</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* check if we already have a translation for this session

   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">get_snatted_count</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">snt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">lookup_nat_forward</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_SNAT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">snt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">snat_packet</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">snt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">snt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">send_touser</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* masquerade_translation() scans masquerade_post list */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">masquerade_translation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* snat_translation scans translation_post list */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">snat_translation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl v-local">send_touser</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">de_dnat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">nat</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1U</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">snat_done</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">snat</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1U</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">userspace_data_pid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">loguser_enabled</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">is_to_send</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">fwopts</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">send_packet_to_userspace_and_update_counters</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">resp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* not sent because of log level */</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Don't check for bad checksum on outgoing packets.
   * See netfilter ip_conntrack_proto_tcp.c comment */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* checksumming... */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">ipfi_response</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nf_hook_state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">state</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                  </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* 0.98.4: When we have to DNAT in output direction, we have to
   * check if the original destination is allowed by the
   * filter rules. Imagine we have setup a proxy web and the
   * user wants to block connections to www.badsite.com.
   * If the output connections are redirected to the proxy
   * by means of an OUTPUT DNAT rule, the connection will
   * pass through also if it is not desired.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">iph_in_get_response</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* decide according to loguser if to send or not feedback */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">userspace_data_pid</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">loguser_enabled</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">is_to_send</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">fwopts</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">skb_touser</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-func-call">build_info_t_nlmsg</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb_touser</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* shouldn't happen :r */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: failed to allocate memory for socket buffer in </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                    </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">iph_in_get_response()</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_send_to_user</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb_touser</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">LISTENER_DATA</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">update_kernel_stats</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_FAILED_NETLINK_USPACE</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Qt-GUI: if gui_notifier_enabled we send the info if there is no match
     * (popup asking the user the verdict for the new seen packet - if
     * directions are in or out -) OR if there was a rule matching and a
     * notification was requested for tha packets matching _that_ rule.
     */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">gui_notifier_enabled</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_IMPLICIT</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_FWD</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">         </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_IMPLICIT</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">notify</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">printk</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">GUI NOTIFIER ENABLED!!</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* previous socket buffer sent to userspace: the kernel will have freed
       * it... so the pointer skb_touser is no more valid: create a new socket
       * buffer with the same ipfire_info_t contents: this will be sent via
       * the notifier socket.
       */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">skb_touser</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-func-call">build_info_t_nlmsg</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">flags</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb_touser</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_send_to_user</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb_touser</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">GUI_NOTIF_DATA</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">failed to send message to userspace via netlink: %d</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                    </span><span class="n v-local">err</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">update_kernel_stats</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_FAILED_NETLINK_USPACE</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* packets not sent because of log level */</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">not_sent</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* update the sum of the packets processed */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_STAT_INC</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">sum</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* update statistics */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">update_kernel_stats</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">direction</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Map internal IPFI verdicts to netfilter verdicts:
   * IPFI_ACCEPT (2) -&gt; NF_ACCEPT (1)
   * IPFI_DROP (1) -&gt; NF_DROP (0)
   * IPFI_IMPLICIT (0) -&gt; apply default_policy
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">res</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">verdict</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_DROP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_DROP</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* IPFI_IMPLICIT: apply default policy */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">default_policy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_ACCEPT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_DROP</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* no more needed since 1.96 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">recalculate_ip_checksum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">direction</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">len</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph_sum_old</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">network_header_null</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">recalculate_ip_checksum()</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                               </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">socket buffer NULL</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">len</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">iph_sum_old</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
