## logging/log.c

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/* ipfi_log.c: a packet to be logged is really sent to userspace only if
 * it is not identical to a one previously sent. This reduces kernel/user
 * communication load */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/***************************************************************************
 *  Copyright  2005  Giacomo
 *  jacum@libero.it
 ****************************************************************************/</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;logging/log.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;globals.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/gfp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/hashtable.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/jhash.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/percpu_counter.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/slab.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/*
 * DESIGN:
 *
 * Log entries follow the unified ipfi_entry lifecycle (table_lifecycle.c):
 *
 * 1. ALLOCATION: kmem_cache_alloc from a dedicated slab cache.
 * 2. LIFECYCLE:  Each entry has an individual timer that fires on
 *                expiration. On duplicate match, the timer is refreshed
 *                via ipfi_entry_update_timer() using IPPROTO_IPFI_LOG
 *                as sentinel protocol (throttled to 5s).
 * 3. REMOVAL:    Timer callback calls ipfi_entry_remove + ipfi_entry_put.
 *                ipfi_entry_put defers to workqueue -&gt; timer_delete_sync
 *                -&gt; call_rcu -&gt; kfree (handles kmem_cache objects on 6.x).
 * 4. MAX CAP:    loginfo_entry_counter is checked before allocation.
 *                If at capacity, the oldest entry is evicted.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Dedicated slab cache for ipfire_loginfo entries ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">kmem_cache</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">loginfo_cache</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/**
 * get_log_hash - compute the hash bucket key for a log-deduplication entry.
 * @saddr:  IPv4 source address (network byte order)
 * @daddr:  IPv4 destination address (network byte order)
 * @proto:  IP protocol number (IPPROTO_TCP, IPPROTO_UDP, IPPROTO_ICMP, …)
 *
 * DESIGN: 3-TUPLE KEY vs. 5-TUPLE (state/NAT tables)
 * ---------------------------------------------------
 * State and NAT tables use the full 5-tuple (saddr, daddr, sport, dport,
 * proto) as their hash key.  This is correct for those tables because each
 * lookup must retrieve *one specific connection*: sport and dport together
 * make every flow unique, so the extra discrimination cuts collision chains
 * to near-zero even at high connection rates.
 *
 * The log-deduplication table has a different contract.  packet_not_seen()
 * never returns a single authoritative entry; it scans every entry in the
 * bucket and delegates the actual equality test to compare_loginfo_packets(),
 * which performs a full content comparison (IPs, ports, flags, direction,
 * rule ID, connection state).  The hash key here is only a *pre-filter*: its
 * job is to route the lookup to the right bucket quickly, not to identify the
 * entry by itself.
 *
 * Using a 3-tuple (saddr, daddr, proto) trades a slightly longer per-bucket
 * scan in exchange for two concrete advantages:
 *
 *   1. PROTOCOL GENERALITY.  ICMP, IGMP, GRE, PIM and other protocols carry
 *      no port numbers.  A 5-tuple key would require special-casing (zero-
 *      filling sport/dport) for each of these, and would still place all
 *      portless packets from the same host pair in the same bucket — so the
 *      extra complexity buys nothing.  The 3-tuple handles all protocols
 *      uniformly with a single code path.
 *
 *   2. LOG SEMANTIC.  A log entry represents &quot;a class of recently-seen
 *      packets between this src/dst pair using this protocol&quot;.  Two TCP
 *      connections from the same client to the same server on different
 *      ephemeral ports are still the same logging event from a firewall
 *      visibility standpoint.  Grouping them in the same bucket is
 *      semantically appropriate; the full comparison in
 *      compare_loginfo_packets() still distinguishes them when needed.
 *
 * Note: with LOG_HASH_BITS=7 (128 buckets) and a typical loginfo table
 * that stays well below max_loginfo_entries, per-bucket chains are short
 * regardless.  A migration to a 5-tuple key (to mirror state/NAT) is a
 * valid future optimisation for very large deployments.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_log_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">proto</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">jhash_3words</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">__u32</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">__u32</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">proto</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Timer callback ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">handle_loginfo_timeout</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">timer_list</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">t</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_loginfo</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">timer_container_of</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">t</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">timer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfi_entry_head</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_list_lock</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/*
   * BUG FIX: check REMOVED *before* list_del_rcu.
   *
   * loginfo_evict_oldest() runs under the same lock and does:
   *   list_del_rcu(lnode) → ipfi_entry_remove (sets REMOVED, puts internally)
   *
   * If eviction already ran, lnode.prev/next are LIST_POISON. Calling
   * list_del_rcu again writes to LIST_POISON address → memory corruption
   * → silent hard panic. Guard with the REMOVED bit which is set atomically
   * by ipfi_entry_remove under this same lock.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">test_bit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">IPFI_ENTRY_REMOVED</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">status</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">list_del_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">lnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_remove</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_entry_counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* puts internally if winner */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_list_lock</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Allocation ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_loginfo</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">loginfo_alloc</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_loginfo</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">kmem_cache_alloc</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_cache</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">GFP_ATOMIC</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memset</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_init</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_lifetime</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">handle_loginfo_timeout</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">refcount_set</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">refcnt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">li</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Eviction (when at capacity) ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="c1">// must be called under spinlock_bh
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">loginfo_evict_oldest</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_loginfo</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">oldest</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Caller MUST hold loginfo_list_lock */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">list_empty</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">active_logi_list</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* lnode removal: ipfi_entry_remove removes hnode in hash mode, so we
   * remove lnode first to keep active_logi_list consistent before remove. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">oldest</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">list_last_entry</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">active_logi_list</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_loginfo</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">lnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">list_del_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">oldest</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">lnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_remove</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">oldest</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_entry_counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* puts internally */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/*
   * BUG FIX: cancel a pending timer before releasing ownership.
   *
   * timer_delete() cancels the timer if it is pending (not yet running).
   * If it is already running on another CPU, that CPU is blocked on
   * loginfo_list_lock (we hold it), so it will check REMOVED (now set)
   * when it gets the lock and will skip list_del_rcu; ipfi_entry_remove
   * will be a no-op (REMOVED bit already set → no put).
   *
   * timer_delete without _sync is safe here: we hold a BH-disabled
   * spinlock and timer_delete_sync would deadlock.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">timer_delete</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">oldest</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">timer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* ---- Header extraction helpers (moved from ipfire.c) ---- */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">build_tcph_usermess</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">tcph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_info_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ipfi_info</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* we fill in our userspace information */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memcpy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ipfi_info</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">packet</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">transport_header</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">tcphead</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">tcph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">         </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">build_udph_usermess</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">p_udphead</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_info_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ipfi_info</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memcpy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ipfi_info</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">packet</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">transport_header</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">udphead</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">p_udphead</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">         </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">p_udphead</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">build_icmph_usermess</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">icmphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">p_icmphead</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                 </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_info_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ipfi_info</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memcpy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ipfi_info</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">packet</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">transport_header</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">icmphead</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">p_icmphead</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">         </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">p_icmphead</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">build_igmph_usermess</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">igmphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">p_igmphead</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                 </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_info_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ipfi_info</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memcpy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ipfi_info</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">packet</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">transport_header</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">igmphead</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">p_igmphead</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">         </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">p_igmphead</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">static</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">copy_headers</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfire_info_t</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">fireinfo</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* protocol information */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-param">fireinfo</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">packet</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">ip</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-param">fireinfo</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">packet</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">ip</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-param">fireinfo</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">packet</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">ip</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* internet header */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* tcp, udp icmp headers? */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_TCP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">build_tcph_usermess</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                        </span><span class="n v-param">fireinfo</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_UDP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">build_udph_usermess</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                        </span><span class="n v-param">fireinfo</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/*

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">chk_state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">st</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">loginfo</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">info</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">response</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">st</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">state</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_entry_update_timer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_IPFI_LOG</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-func-call">rcu_read_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">rcu_read_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">smart_log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">              </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">packet_not_seen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">add_packet_to_infolist</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">smart_log_with_state_check</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                               </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">response</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                               </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                               </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">info_flags</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">packet_not_seen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">add_packet_to_infolist</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">res</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">flags</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">init_log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_cache</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">kmem_cache_create</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">ipfi_loginfo</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">ipfire_loginfo</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                        </span><span class="n v-local">SLAB_HWCACHE_ALIGN</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_cache</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: failed to create loginfo slab cache</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n v-local">ENOMEM</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">percpu_counter_init</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_entry_counter</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">GFP_KERNEL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">fini_log</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Flush all active entries using the unified lifecycle.
   *
   * BUG FIX (hash mode): ipfi_table_flush_hash() only unlinks hnode;
   * it leaves lnode dangling in active_logi_list → UAF on any further
   * traversal. loginfo entries maintain BOTH lnode and hnode, so we
   * always drain via active_logi_list (lnode-based), which also covers
   * both links. In hash mode, entries are set REMOVED so timer callbacks
   * become no-ops after this.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">ipfi_table_flush_all</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">active_logi_list</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_list_lock</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                       </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_entry_counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">percpu_counter_destroy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">loginfo_entry_counter</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* kmem_cache_destroy deferred to ipfire.c::fini() after
   * destroy_workqueue + rcu_barrier ensure all kfree callbacks ran. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

## helpers/ftp.h

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFI_FTP_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_FTP_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* See ipfi.c for details and

 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../nat/nat.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfi_machine.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;netlink/ipfi_netl.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">typedef</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ftp_addr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ftp_port</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">valid</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">ftp_info</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* returns 1 if a new entry is added, 0 if the skb data do not
 * contain ftp 227 information about ip and port,
 * -1 if an error occurs */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">ftp_support</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">tentry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* if skb data contain ftp address and port, allocate and return the new entry
 * to be added to the dynamic tables list */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">packet_contains_ftp_params</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                           </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">orig_entry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                           </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* just inspect if skb contains 227 command  (&quot;Entering passive mode&quot;) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">data_start_with_227</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* returns a new kmallocated struct state_table. It is the copy of the
 * original ftp table, with the new address and port.
 * _Remember_ to initialize a new timer and to add the rule at the tail
 * of the list in the calling function. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">get_params_and_alloc_newentry</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">orig</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/** inspects skb data and retrieves ftp address and port.
 * @return a structure of type ftp_info, which has the flag valid
 * set to 1 if it is valid, 0 if something failed. The caller must
 * check against the valid flag.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n nc">ftp_info</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_ftpaddr_and_port</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* takes ftp string and fills in integers representing ip and port */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_u8s</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">a1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">a2</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">a3</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">a4</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">p1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">p2</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* checks a bit of syntax in buffer related to 227 command */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">check_buf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ftpcmd</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">clean_ftp_command</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">cleaned</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">rehash_ftp_expectation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">new_sport</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">lookup_ftp_expectation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                           </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">iph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                           </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                           </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">reverse</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                           </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

## helpers/ftp.c

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/* ip firewall Giacomo S.
 * Passive ftp support module */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/***************************************************************************
 *  Copyright  2005  Giacomo
 *  jacum@libero.it
 ****************************************************************************/</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/*
 *  This program is free software; you can redistribute it and/or modify
 *  it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 *  the Free Software Foundation; either version 2 of the License, or
 *  (at your option) any later version.
 *
 *  This program is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 *  but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 *  MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.  See the
 *  GNU General Public License for more details.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* see ipfi.c for details */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;helpers/ftp.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../filter/state/state_table.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;globals.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfi_machine.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;netlink/ipfi_netl.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/list.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/module.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define FTPBUF 256</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define CLEANEDBUF 128</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">MODULE_LICENSE</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">GPL</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">MODULE_AUTHOR</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">Giacomo S. &lt;jacum@libero.it&gt;</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">MODULE_DESCRIPTION</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">Passive FTP support module</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Removed thread-unsafe global: char ftp_buffer[FTPBUF]; */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* returns 1 if a new entry is added, 0 if the skb data do not
 * contain ftp 227 information about ip and port,
 * -1 if an error occurs
 * Comes from:
 * -iph_in_get_response();
 * - ipfire_filter();
 * - check_state();
 * skb already checked in ipfi_response() against `NULL' value
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">ftp_support</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">tentry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">FTPBUF</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">packet_contains_ftp_params</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">tentry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* if skb data contain ftp address and port, allocate and return the new entry
 * to be added to the dynamic tables list */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n v-global">packet_contains_ftp_params</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                           </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">orig_entry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                           </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">newt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">data_start_with_227</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">newt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_params_and_alloc_newentry</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">orig_entry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">newt</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* just inspect if skb contains 227 command  (&quot;Entering passive mode&quot;).
 * Handles multi-response segments: when FTP commands are pipelined (e.g.
 * USER/PASS/PASV/QUIT sent at once), the server may reply with several
 * response lines concatenated in a single TCP segment.  We must search for
 * the &quot;227&quot; line anywhere in the payload, not just at byte 0.
 *
 * On success, ftp_buffer contains ONLY the &quot;227 ...(A,B,C,D,p,q)\r\n&quot; line
 * (subsequent lines are stripped) so that check_buf / get_ftpaddr_and_port
 * can parse it correctly.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">data_start_with_227</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dataoff</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">data_ptr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">p</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">eol</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* a packet arrives here if protocol is TCP, see check_state() */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">dataoff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">doff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* If there is no data in the buffer, return -1 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">dataoff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">len</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dataoff</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">FTPBUF</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">FTPBUF</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">data_ptr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_header_pointer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">dataoff</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">data_ptr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: fb_ptr NULL! (ipfi_ftp.c)</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">data_ptr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">memcpy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">data_ptr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="sc">\0</span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* 227 ( ) A,B,C,D,p,q -&gt; minimal string representing a 227 command */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">datalen</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">16</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Search for &quot;227&quot; at the start of any response line.
   * FTP response lines are delimited by \r\n, so a mid-buffer 227 is
   * always preceded by \n (or it is at position 0). */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">while</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">strstr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">p</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">227</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Accept if it's at position 0 or preceded by \n */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="sc">\n</span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* Isolate this single line: find the \n that ends it */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">eol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">strchr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">p</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="sc">\n</span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">eol</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">eol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="sc">\0</span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* keep the \n, remove whatever follows */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* Now move the 227 line to the start of ftp_buffer */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE FTP: found 227 line: %s</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">p</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* advance past this non-matching &quot;227&quot; occurrence */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
