</span><span class="cm">/* checks a bit of syntax in buffer related to 227 command.
 * Note: some FTP servers append characters after ')' before \r\n, e.g.:
 *   227 Entering Passive Mode (85,188,1,133,213,231).\r\n
 * so we search backwards for ')' rather than requiring it at a fixed offset. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kr">inline</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">check_buf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ftpcmd</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">strlen</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ftpcmd</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">j</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">commas</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">parenthesis</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">FTPBUF</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ftpcmd</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="sc">\n</span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ftpcmd</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="sc">\r</span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Search backwards from \r for ')'; allow trailing chars like '.' */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">for</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">j</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">j</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">j</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ftpcmd</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">j</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="sc">)</span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">break</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">j</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">for</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">len</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">FTPBUF</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ftpcmd</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="sc">,</span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">commas</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ftpcmd</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="sc">(</span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">parenthesis</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">commas</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">parenthesis</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* takes ftp string and fills in integers representing ip and port */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">clean_ftp_command</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">cleaned</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">j</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">check_buf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: bad format for 227 ftp command: </span><span class="se">\&quot;</span><span class="s">%s</span><span class="se">\&quot;</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">while</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">FTPBUF</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="sc">\0</span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="sc">(</span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* reached '(', ftp_buffer[i] points to '(' */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* pass '(' */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">while</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">FTPBUF</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">j</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">CLEANEDBUF</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="sc">\0</span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">         </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="sc">)</span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-param">cleaned</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">j</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">i</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">j</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">+</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-param">cleaned</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">j</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="sc">\0</span><span class="sc">'</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* Terminate string */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* inspects skb data and retrieves ftp address and port.
 * returns a structure of type ftp_info, which has the flag valid
 * set to 1 if it is valid, 0 if something failed. The caller must
 * check against the valid flag.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="n nc">ftp_info</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">get_ftpaddr_and_port</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">ftp_info</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ftpi</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">invalid_ftpinfo</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">cleaned</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">CLEANEDBUF</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">a1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">a2</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">a3</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">a4</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">p1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">p2</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">n</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">m</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">o</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memset</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">ftpi</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ftp_info</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memset</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">invalid_ftpinfo</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">invalid_ftpinfo</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* validate the ftp_info aimed at containing a valid result */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ftpi</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">valid</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">clean_ftp_command</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">cleaned</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">ftp_buffer</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: error cleaning ftp buffer!</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">invalid_ftpinfo</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">sscanf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">cleaned</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">%hhu,%hhu,%hhu,%hhu,%hhu,%hhu</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">a1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">a2</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">a3</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">a4</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">p1</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">             </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">p2</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">6</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE: sscanf failed on cleaned buffer: %s</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">cleaned</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">invalid_ftpinfo</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* compute address */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ftpi</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">ftp_addr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">a4</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">n</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">a1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">n</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">n</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">24</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">m</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">a2</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">m</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">m</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">16</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">o</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">a3</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">o</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">o</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ftpi</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">ftp_addr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ftpi</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">ftp_addr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">n</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">m</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">o</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ftpi</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">ftp_addr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">htonl</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ftpi</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">ftp_addr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* port */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">n</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">p1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">n</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">n</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ftpi</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">ftp_port</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">p2</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">n</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">ftpi</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">ftp_port</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">htons</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ftpi</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">ftp_port</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">IPFIRE FTP: Parsed PASV response: IP %pI4, Port %u</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">              </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">ftpi</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">ftp_addr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ntohs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">ftpi</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">ftp_port</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ftpi</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="cm">/*
 * rehash_ftp_expectation — one-shot optimisation for FTP passive data flows.
 *
 * When a passive-mode FTP 227 response is parsed, we create an expectation
 * entry with sport=0 (wildcard) because the client's ephemeral data port is
 * unknown at that point.  This entry is hashed into the sport=0 bucket.
 *
 * On the first data-connection packet, lookup_ftp_expectation() finds the
 * entry via the sport=0 bucket (secondary lookup).  The caller may then
 * invoke this function to:
 *   1. Fill in the real client source port (new_sport).
 *   2. Move the entry from the sport=0 bucket to the correct 5-tuple bucket.
 *   3. Set ftp = FTP_ESTABLISHED so subsequent packets hit the normal O(1)
 *      hash path and bypass the secondary lookup entirely.
 *
 * This is purely an optimisation — without it, every data packet would go
 * through the secondary lookup, which is still correct but O(bucket_size)
 * per packet.  For FTP traffic volumes, either approach is acceptable.
 *
 * Lock ordering: when two distinct buckets must be locked, the lower-numbered
 * bucket is always locked first to prevent AB-BA deadlocks.
 *
 * NOT WIRED UP YET — call site needs to be added once the caller decides
 * to use this optimisation.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-global">rehash_ftp_expectation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">new_sport</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_key</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_state_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                 </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* MUST use hash_min() — same function as
   * hash_add_rcu/hash_for_each_possible_rcu */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">hash_min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">old_key</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">STATE_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_key</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_state_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">new_sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                 </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">hash_min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">new_key</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">STATE_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">new_sport</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ftp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">FTP_ESTABLISHED</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* Lock ordering to prevent deadlocks */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">hlist_del_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">new_sport</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ftp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">FTP_ESTABLISHED</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">hash_add_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">state_hashtable</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hnode</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_key</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">old_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">spin_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">state_bucket_locks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">new_bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/*
 * lookup_ftp_expectation — secondary hash lookup for FTP passive data flows.
 *
 * The FTP helper creates expectation entries with sport=0 (wildcard) because
 * the client's ephemeral source port is unknown when parsing the 227 response.
 * These entries live in the hash bucket keyed by:
 *   get_state_hash(client_ip, server_data_ip, 0, server_data_port, TCP)
 *
 * For passive FTP, the client opens the data connection to the server:
 *   src = client_ip : client_ephemeral   (sport of the outgoing SYN)
 *   dst = server_data_ip : server_data_port  (dport of the outgoing SYN)
 *
 * So we probe the hash with dport (= server data port), which matches
 * the expectation's stored dport.  The sport wildcard (0) is handled
 * inside direct_state_match() when ftp == FTP_DEFINED.
 *
 * Must be called under rcu_read_lock_bh().
 *
 * Returns the matched state_table entry, or NULL if no expectation matches.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-global">lookup_ftp_expectation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                           </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">iph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                           </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                           </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">reverse</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                           </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">ipfi_flow</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">table_entry</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Probe with sport=0 (wildcard) and the server data port as dport.
   * MUST use hash_for_each_possible_rcu — it internally applies hash_min()
   * (golden-ratio multiplicative hash) to map the key to a bucket, which is
   * the same function that hash_add_rcu used when storing the entry.
   * A manual &quot;key &amp; mask&quot; bitmask computes a DIFFERENT bucket! */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ftp_key</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_state_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_TCP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">hash_for_each_possible_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">state_hashtable</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">table_entry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hnode</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ftp_key</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">table_entry</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ftp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">FTP_DEFINED</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_matches_state_table</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">table_entry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">reverse</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">iph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                  </span><span class="n v-param">flow</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">table_entry</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

## helpers/icmp_nat.h

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">ifndef IPFI_ICMP_NAT_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">define IPFI_ICMP_NAT_H</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../filter/state/state_table.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/skbuff.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Handle internal rewriting of ICMP errors that reference heavily-NATed
 * connections. hooknum expected: NF_INET_PRE_ROUTING or NF_INET_POST_ROUTING.
 * Returns 1 on success, -1 otherwise.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">icmp_nat_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">hooknum</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Matches ICMP error payload against a state entry */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">match_icmp_error_payload</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                             </span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">state_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">entry</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">short</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">reverse</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cm">/* Hashes the inner IP payload of an ICMP error for state table lookups */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">get_icmp_inner_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">const</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">__u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">hash_key</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">endif </span><span class="cm">/* IPFI_ICMP_NAT_H */</span><span class="cp">
</span></pre>

## helpers/icmp_nat.c

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/*
 * nat/icmp_nat.c: ICMP NAT Logic
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;icmp_nat.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../../filter/state/state_table.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../ipfi_machine.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../nat/nat.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;../nat/nat_table.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/icmp.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/ip.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">
</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&lt;linux/skbuff.h&gt;</span><span class="cp">

 * header */</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Ensure we have the ICMP header */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">pskb_may_pull</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">icmphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Check if it's an ICMP error type */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">icmph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ICMP_DEST_UNREACH</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">icmph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ICMP_TIME_EXCEEDED</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* The inner IP header starts after the ICMP header (8 bytes) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">pskb_may_pull</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Recompute pointers after potential pull */</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Ensure we have enough of the inner L4 header (at least 8 bytes for ports)
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-func-call">pskb_may_pull</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
