</span><span class="cm">/*
 * icmp_nat_process: Handle NAT translation for ICMP error packets.
 * This function translates the outer IP header and the embedded inner headers
 * to correctly route an ICMP error packet across the NAT.
 */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf v-global">icmp_nat_process</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">sk_buff</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">hooknum</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">icmphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">icmph</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">inner_l4h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">net_quadruplet</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">u32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">key</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">nat_table</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">nat_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">n_type</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">u8</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">!</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* We only process IPv4 ICMP packets here */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_ICMP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">get_inner_headers</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">inner_l4h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">icmph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">icmphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Extract the inner network quadruplet.
   * Note: The inner packet represents the ORIGINAL traffic that caused the
   * error.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">memset</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">valid</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Capture the inner protocol early to prevent TOCTOU drift */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_TCP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">inner_l4h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">source</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">dest</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_UDP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">inner_l4h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">source</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">dest</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="cm">/* We only handle ICMP errors for TCP/UDP inner payloads right now */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">IPFI_PRINTK</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">ipfire: icmp_nat: inner proto %u not supported</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                </span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">// IPFI_PRINTK(&quot;ipfire: icmp_nat: inner quad s=%pI4:%u d=%pI4:%u prot=%u\n&quot;,
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">//             &amp;inner_quad.saddr, ntohs(inner_quad.sport), &amp;inner_quad.daddr,
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="c1">//             ntohs(inner_quad.dport), inner_proto);
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/*
   * Look up the inner tuple in the NAT tables.
   * The inner packet corresponds to the POSTNAT index because the original
   * packet has ALREADY been translated before it caused the error downstream.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">key</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">get_nat_tuple_hash</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                           </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">key</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="o">&lt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_HASH_BITS</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">rcu_read_lock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Try DNAT ORIG index using hash_for_each_rcu since the inner_quad hash key
   * doesn't match the client IP hashed in NAT_IDX_ORIG.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">n_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_DNAT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iter_bkt</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">hash_for_each_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nat_hashtables</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">n_type</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_ORIG</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">iter_bkt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                      </span><span class="n v-local">h</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">hnode</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Define IP Terminology for DNAT:
         * A  = Client (Original Source)       -&gt; nt-&gt;old_saddr
         * B  = Firewall Public IP             -&gt; nt-&gt;old_daddr
         * B' = Firewall Masq/Local IP         -&gt; nt-&gt;our_ifaddr (if SNAT'd too)
         * C  = DNAT Server (Internal Target)  -&gt; nt-&gt;new_addr
         *
         * Expected inner packet (the original packet that hit the error):
         * expected_saddr is A (if pure DNAT) or B' (if DNAT + Masquerade).
         */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">expected_saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">our_ifaddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">?</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">our_ifaddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_saddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Match Case 1: Error generated by FORWARD-direction traffic.
         * &quot;Forward&quot; means the traffic was flowing Client A -&gt; Server C.
         * Server C received A's packet, rejected it, and sent an ICMP error
         * back. The Inner Quad is that original packet sent TO Server C: Src =
         * expected_saddr (A or B') Dst = nt-&gt;new_addr (C)
         */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">expected_saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">new_addr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">new_port</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_hold_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">match_found</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Match Case 2: Error generated by REVERSE-direction traffic.
         * &quot;Reverse&quot; means the traffic was flowing Server C -&gt; Client A.
         * Client A (or the firewall B) received C's response, rejected it,
         * and sent an ICMP error back to C.
         * The Inner Quad is that original packet sent FROM Server C:
         *   Src = nt-&gt;new_addr (C)
         *   Dst = expected_saddr (A or B')
         */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">new_addr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">new_port</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">expected_saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_sport</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_hold_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">match_found</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Match Case 3: DNAT forward direction in POST_ROUTING.
         * The PRE_ROUTING hook already completely translated the inner packet
         * back to its original pre-NAT state (A -&gt; B).
         * Inner Quad is now:
         *   Src = nt-&gt;old_saddr (A)
         *   Dst = nt-&gt;old_daddr (B)
         */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_INET_POST_ROUTING</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_dport</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_hold_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">match_found</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Try SNAT POSTNAT index */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">n_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_SNAT</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">hlist_for_each_entry_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">nat_hashtables</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">n_type</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_POSTNAT</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">bkt</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                           </span><span class="n v-local">h_indices</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n v-local">NAT_IDX_POSTNAT</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* Define IP Terminology for SNAT:
       * A  = Client (Original Source)       -&gt; nt-&gt;old_saddr
       * B  = Firewall Public IP             -&gt; nt-&gt;old_daddr
       * B' = Firewall Masq/Local IP         -&gt; nt-&gt;our_ifaddr or nt-&gt;new_addr
       * C  = Remote Server                  -&gt; nt-&gt;old_daddr
       *
       * Match Case: SNAT forward direction (client A to server C).
       * Server C generated the ICMP error back to B'.
       * Inner Quad is the packet sent TO Server C (post-SNAT):
       *   Src = expected_saddr (B', the translated source)
       *   Dst = nt-&gt;old_daddr (C)
       */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">expected_saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">our_ifaddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">?</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">our_ifaddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">:</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">new_addr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">expected_saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">new_port</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_dport</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_hold_rcu</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="k">goto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">match_found</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">rcu_read_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* No translation matched */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="nl v-local">match_found</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">rcu_read_unlock_bh</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/*
   * It is safe to copy fields into locals after rcu_read_unlock_bh()
   * because we held a reference count via nat_hold_rcu() inside the
   * critical section. The memory won't be freed, and these 5-tuple
   * fields are immutable once initialized.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_old_saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_saddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_old_daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_daddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_new_addr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">new_addr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_old_sport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_sport</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_old_dport</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">old_dport</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_new_port</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">new_port</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">enum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n nc">nat_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">type</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_our_ifaddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">our_ifaddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* We must ensure skb is writable before making modifications.
   * Only need it up to the end of the inner L4 header we plan to modify.
   * Note: 'needed' is an offset from skb-&gt;data, so it implicitly covers
   * all outer headers (IP and ICMP).
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">int</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">needed</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">unsigned</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kt">char</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">inner_l4h</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">data</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_TCP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">needed</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_UDP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">needed</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">skb_ensure_writable</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">needed</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">net_ratelimit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">printk</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">KERN_DEBUG</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">             </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">ipfire: icmp_nat: skb_ensure_writable failed (needed %u)</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">             </span><span class="n v-local">needed</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Re-fetch pointers after skb_ensure_writable */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">ip_hdr</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">icmph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">icmphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">iphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">icmph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">sizeof</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">icmphdr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-local">inner_l4h</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="kt">void</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">ihl</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/* Defensive TOCTOU check: ensure the protocol hasn't been modified
   * concurrently by another packet processor before the skb was linearized */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">unlikely</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">|</span><span class="o">|</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">               </span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">protocol</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-func-call">net_ratelimit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">printk</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">KERN_WARNING</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="s">ipfire: icmp_nat: inner protocol drift detected!</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-func-call">nat_put</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">-1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="cm">/*
   * For NF_IP_PRE_ROUTING, the error is coming from the outside returning
   * inside. For NF_IP_POST_ROUTING, the error is generated inside returning
   * outside.
   */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-param">hooknum</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NF_INET_PRE_ROUTING</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_SNAT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/*
       * SNAT PREROUTING: Error coming back from external host (reply to SNAT
       * client). Outer destination and Inner source must change from
       * `new_addr` (or `our_ifaddr` for masquerading) to `old_saddr`.
       * Inner source port must change from `new_port` to `old_sport`.
       */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_ip</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_old_saddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_ip</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_port</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_old_sport</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_port</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* 1. Modify outer destination IP */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">csum_replace4</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_ip</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_ip</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* 2. Modify inner source address */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-func-call">csum_replace4</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_ip</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_ip</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_ip</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* Update inner L4 checksum for pseudo-header IP change */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_TCP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">inner_l4h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">inet_proto_csum_replace4</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_ip</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_ip</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">true</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">inner_l4h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-func-call">inet_proto_csum_replace4</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_ip</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_ip</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">true</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/* 3. Modify inner source port */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">old_port</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_port</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_TCP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">inner_l4h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-func-call">inet_proto_csum_replace2</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_port</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_port</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">false</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">source</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_port</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">udphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">inner_l4h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-func-call">inet_proto_csum_replace2</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_port</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_port</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                     </span><span class="nb v-local">false</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-local">uh</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">source</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_port</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">ret</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">nt_type</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">NAT_DNAT</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="cm">/*
       * DNAT PREROUTING: ICMP error from/to a DNATed destination.
       */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_new_addr</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/*
         * DNAT Forward direction error (Client A to Server C).
         * Inner Quad is the packet sent TO Server C.
         * We must reverse the DNAT (and any SNAT/masquerade) on the OUTER Dst
         * and on all INNER headers.
         *
         * We use inner_quad.daddr (= C) as the match key, NOT
         * outer_iph-&gt;daddr (= B', the masquerade addr). The inner packet
         * is the post-NAT original that reached the server; its destination
         * is C = nt_new_addr. The outer destination is the masq addr (B'),
         * which is unrelated to the NAT entry's new_addr.
         *
         * Ideally the outer Src after translation should be B (the firewall's
         * public address), because A thinks it was talking to B. However,
         * changing the outer Src to B (a local IP) causes the kernel's
         * fib_validate_source to reject the packet as a martian source (a
         * local address arriving on the external interface). Therefore we
         * leave the outer Src as C (the server that generated the error).
         * This is the same behaviour as iptables DNAT + MASQUERADE.
         *
         * IP Terminology:
         * A  = Client (Original Source)       = nt_old_saddr
         * B  = Firewall Public IP             = nt_old_daddr
         * B' = Firewall Masq/Local IP         = nt_our_ifaddr /
         * inner_iph-&gt;saddr C  = DNAT Server (Internal Target)  = nt_new_addr
         *
         * As seen on the wire (arriving on firewall):
         *   Outer IP: Src=C (server .49)  Dst=B' (masq addr .245)
         *   Inner IP: Src=B' (masq .245)  Dst=C  (server .49)
         *
         * After translation (forwarded to original client A):
         *   Outer IP: Src=C (.49, UNCHANGED - see above)  Dst=A (client .25)
         *   Inner IP: Src=A (client .25)   Dst=B (firewall public .245)
         */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_inner_s</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* B' (masq IP) or A (client) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_s</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_old_saddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">     </span><span class="cm">/* A  (original client) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_inner_d</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* C  (DNAT target server) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_d</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_old_daddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* B  (public FW, pre-DNAT dst) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_inner_sp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">sport</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_sp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_old_sport</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_inner_dp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">inner_quad</span><span class="p">.</span><span class="n v-member">dport</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n nc">__be16</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_dp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">nt_old_dport</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* 1. Fix Outer Dst: B' -&gt; A
         *    Outer Src (C) is NOT changed — keep server as sender. */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">csum_replace4</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_s</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_s</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* 2. Fix Inner IP Headers */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Inner Src: B' -&gt; A */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">csum_replace4</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_inner_s</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_s</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_s</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* Inner Dst: C -&gt; B */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-func-call">csum_replace4</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_inner_d</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_d</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n v-local">inner_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">daddr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_d</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/* 3. Fix Inner L4 Header (pseudo-header + port updates) */</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">inner_proto</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPPROTO_TCP</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">struct</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc nc">tcphdr</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">*</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="n v-local">inner_l4h</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-func-call">inet_proto_csum_replace4</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_inner_s</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_s</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                   </span><span class="nb v-local">true</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="n v-func-call">inet_proto_csum_replace4</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_inner_d</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_d</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                   </span><span class="nb v-local">true</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">old_inner_sp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_sp</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-func-call">inet_proto_csum_replace2</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_inner_sp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                     </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_sp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">false</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">source</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_sp</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">          </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">old_inner_dp</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_dp</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">{</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-func-call">inet_proto_csum_replace2</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">&amp;</span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">check</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_inner_dp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">                                     </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_dp</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">false</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="n v-local">th</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">dest</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">new_inner_dp</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/*

         * This ICMP error was already partially translated in PRE_ROUTING.
         * The inner headers are already de-NATed back to original (Src=A,
         * Dst=B). Outer Dst was already changed to A.
         *
         * IP Terminology:
         * A  = Client (Original Source)       = nt_old_saddr
         * B  = Firewall Public IP             = nt_old_daddr
         * C  = DNAT Server (Internal Target)  = nt_new_addr
         *

         * sees the ICMP as coming from B — the address it thinks it is
         * talking to.

         * (masquerade-like).

</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="n nc">__be32</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">old_src</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">outer_iph</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">saddr</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cm">/* C (server, .49) */</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">        </span><span class="cm">/*

</span><span class="cm">/* Helper: send a single skb to userspace with retry on failure.

</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">com</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">cmd</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">IPFIRE_BUSY</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">com</span><span class="o">-</span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="n v-member">anumber</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">userspace_control_pid</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="n v-local">skb</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">build_command_packet</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">com</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">!</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nb v-local">NULL</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">status</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-func-call">send_data_to_user</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">skb</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-param">pid</span><span class="p">,</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">sknl_ipfi_control</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">    </span><span class="k">else</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">      </span><span class="n v-local">status</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">-</span><span class="n v-local">ENOMEM</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="n v-func-call">kfree</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n v-local">com</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="w">  </span><span class="k">return</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n v-local">status</span><span class="p">;</span><span class="w">
</span><span class="p">}</span><span class="w">
</span></pre>

<pre class="source-code"><span class="cm">/* netlink/netlink.c: Netlink socket management for ipfire-wall */</span><span class="w">

</span><span class="cp">#</span><span class="cp">include</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="cpf">&quot;ipfire.h&quot;</span><span class="cp">
